newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia welcomes Milosevic decision on local polls.
newsitem.headline: Russia welcomes Milosevic decision on local polls.

text.p: Russia on Thursday welcomed Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic's decision to ask parliament to reinstate opposition victories in local elections and said the chance to ease tension must not be missed.

"This provides a real opportunity to resolve the political crisis and put an end to many days of confrontation," Interfax news agency quoted ministry spokesman Mikhail Demurin as telling a news briefing.
"The opportunity to quickly defuse the situation in Yugoslavia, which is important for the entire region, must not be missed."
Serbia's refusal to recognise opposition victories in last November's municipal elections has prompted weeks of protests in Belgrade.
The autocratic Milosevic wrote to his prime minister on Tuesday asking parliament to reinstate the results in 14 cities, including Belgrade.
The government then approved a draft law on ratifying the results, which is to be put to parliament next week.

"The Serbian authorities have shown they are ready for a political decision," said Demurin, whose country is a long-time ally of Milosevic. He said both sides must avoid violence in trying to solve the dispute.
